name: onexplayer-superx-tools
description: Decky Loader plugin for ONEXPLAYER SUPER X oxpec EC support

scripts.prebuild: echo "export const BUILD_ID = \"build-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)\";" > src/build_info.ts && echo "BUILD_ID = \"build-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)\"" > py_modules/build_info.py
scripts.package: bun run verify:oxpec-superx && bun run prebuild && rollup -c && rm -rf 'ONEXPLAYER SUPER X Tools' && mkdir -p 'ONEXPLAYER SUPER X Tools/dist' 'ONEXPLAYER SUPER X Tools/py_modules' 'ONEXPLAYER SUPER X Tools/assets' && cp package.json plugin.json main.py 'ONEXPLAYER SUPER X Tools/' && cp dist/index.js 'ONEXPLAYER SUPER X Tools/dist/' && cp py_modules/*.py 'ONEXPLAYER SUPER X Tools/py_modules/' && mkdir -p 'ONEXPLAYER SUPER X Tools/py_modules/oxpec' && for d in py_modules/oxpec/*/; do [ -f "${d}oxpec.ko" ] && cp -r "$d" 'ONEXPLAYER SUPER X Tools/py_modules/oxpec/' || true; done && cp assets/* 'ONEXPLAYER SUPER X Tools/assets/' && rm -f OneXPlayer_Super_X_Tools.zip && zip -r OneXPlayer_Super_X_Tools.zip 'ONEXPLAYER SUPER X Tools' && rm -rf 'ONEXPLAYER SUPER X Tools'
scripts.deploy: bun run package && cp OneXPlayer_Super_X_Tools.zip ~/Downloads/ && echo 'Copied OneXPlayer_Super_X_Tools.zip to ~/Downloads/'
scripts.install-plugin: bun run package && sudo unzip -o OneXPlayer_Super_X_Tools.zip -d ~/homebrew/plugins/ && sudo systemctl restart plugin_loader && echo 'Plugin installed and loader restarted'
